judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A visually pleasing sky with rich cloud texture and soft lighting, though it lacks the drama or color to be truly outstanding.
strengths: pleasing contrast between bright highlights and shadowed bases
good coverage of the sky without being empty
weaknesses: light is somewhat flat and lacks dramatic color
building in corner adds minor distraction
no strong focal point or mood
